description: Boolean status flag stored as string with inconsistent textual representations across 30 records (no missing values). Values appear as mixed conventions: 'True'/'False', '1'/'0', and 'yes'/'no', representing two logical states. The column is stored as string but intended to be boolean type.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert all string representations to boolean type: 'True' → True, '1' → True, 'yes' → True, 'False' → False, '0' → False, 'no' → False.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to strict boolean format (True or False) after standardization.
